purpose: Independent practice of C4 step 2 (data collection).
student_learning_goal: I can collect data to answer a math question about a real-life situation.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can collect data to answer a math question about a real-life situation.
header.character_watermark: Sap Sam the Collector in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Look at each bush. Count the trees. Record your count in the tally box.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four labelled bush pictures with tally boxes.

image_placeholders.description: Four small B&W line-art bush pictures arranged in a 2x2 grid, ~7in x 3.5in total. Each bush has a different number of trees (3, 5, 4, 6) drawn simply. Below each bush is a tally box with 'Trees: ___' label. Header 'Count the Trees:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_BUSH_COUNT: keywords (count, trees) name what the activity asks for.

parts.student_instructions: Use your tree counts from Part 1 to answer these 3 questions.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three numbered question slots with answer lines.

image_placeholders.description: Three numbered question slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Q1 'Which bush has the MOST trees? ___'. Q2 'Which bush has the FEWEST? ___'. Q3 'How many trees in ALL? ___'. Header 'Use Your Data:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_DATA_QUESTIONS: keywords (data, questions) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Most: Bush 4 (6). Fewest: Bush 1 (3). Total: 18 trees.

parts.student_instructions: Pick something to count in your day (crayons, books, friends). Draw it and count. Then write 1 question your count answers.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A drawing area with a tally box and question line.

image_placeholders.description: A blank drawing area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in, with a tally box on the right and 1 question line below. Header 'My Real-Life Count:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_MY_COUNT: keywords (real-life, count) name what the activity asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Child counts a real-life thing and writes a question their count answers.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, count something else and add a tally row to Part 3.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 worksheet practices C4 step 2 (data). Watch for children who write 'a lot' or 'many' instead of a number — redirect to a tally.
